source.description:
王渝萱’s Golden Horse Nomination

22-year-old actress 王渝萱 leans casually on a railing in a modern interior, her dark blazer contrasting with a light blouse. Her warm smile and relaxed posture reflect the confidence she’s gained from her recent nomination for Best Supporting Actress at the 58th Golden Horse Awards.

In the film 《該死的阿修羅》, 王渝萱 portrays a rebellious teen who hides vulnerability beneath a tough exterior. Director 樓一安 praised her as a “genius actor,” though she modestly insists that her achievements stem from hard work.
